text: 何立峰会见金融监管总局国际咨询委员会委员时指出 中国将继续扩大金融高水平开放 加快建设金融强国
text_en: He Lifeng, during a meeting with members of the International Advisory Committee of the National Financial Regulatory Administration, stated that China will continue to expand high-level financial opening and accelerate the building of a financial powerhouse
